html: Google Analytics is my tool of choice for viewing and analyzing site statistics. Here is an image from a recent report about Tyler Brothers, showing the impact of a permission-based email that was sent to about 500 Tyler Brothers customers. You can see that site visits doubled on days when the emails were distributed.
